note: This package installs and runs from the built-in chatgpt profile plus a captured session snapshot of chatgpt.com. Bundles read the access token from the same-origin /api/auth/session response (Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>); token refresh is broadcast on a BroadcastChannel named auth-session (event access-token-refreshed-v1). provider-catalog classifies chatgpt-web / chatgpt-web-codex as cookie auth — unknown whether the session token lives in a cookie vs an httponly session; capture once headed and record the cookie/localStorage set in state.json. Selectors and SSE delta-event literal are unverified pending first live capture.
